policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final regulations provide guidance for automatic enrollment requirements that apply to certain retirement plans.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your retirement plan participation is subject to new automatic enrollment requirements starting January 19, 2027.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: Amazon is set to acquire AI startup Decart's chip software and hire its founders, in a deal reportedly valued at $7.5 billion, aiming to boost the speed and efficiency of its custom chips.
CrowdStrike will acquire Zscaler in a $44 billion deal, as cybersecurity companies increase their defenses in response to advanced AI-supercharged cyberattacks.
Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia's CEO and board chair, a decision reportedly influenced by President Trump and followed by a significant surge in Nvidia's shares.

world.summary: Ukraine announced that its forces sank the Russian warship Merkury off the coast of Libya.
The COP31 climate summit concluded without a consensus agreement for the first time in 17 years, due to disagreements over fossil fuels and financing for climate-vulnerable nations.
India has pledged $1.6 billion in flood relief for Nepal following a visit by Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah to New Delhi.

Denmark's top court upheld the country's controversial 'ghetto law,' ruling that the eviction of 'non-Western' families from certain areas did not constitute discrimination, supporting the nation's hardline immigration policy.

us.summary: The U.S. Army has rescheduled the detonation of approximately five tons of bomb-making material in Iowa for Wednesday, citing weather conditions and mitigation measures.
Food banks across the country are experiencing increased demand as the holiday season approaches, with higher grocery prices contributing to more individuals seeking assistance.
The Labor Department proposed a regulation aimed at curbing the use of ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) funds in workplace retirement plans, including 401(k)s.

science.summary: The NHS has launched the world's largest trial to investigate if artificial intelligence can improve the early diagnosis of breast cancer during screening, potentially easing pressure on healthcare services.
Scientists successfully sequenced the entire genome of a whale by collecting samples of its snot using commercial drones equipped with petri dishes.
